title: Chinese Academy of Social Science psychic abilities laboratory
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Chinese Academy of Social Science psychic abilities laboratory, about end of the Cold War (c. 1990s) at Beijing, China, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: as soon as I showed up the first thing she did is she brought me to the laboratory showing me all these experiments they were doing with psychic abilities and they were exploring and trying to figure out what what all this was

plain: A man named Dan Sheehan says that around the end of the Cold War, in the 1990s, he visited the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, a state research body in Beijing. He says the woman who hosted him, whom he names as Jen Jo Jing, first took him to a laboratory where they were running experiments on psychic abilities, trying to understand what they were. If true, it would mean the Chinese state was seriously studying the powers of the mind.
